data.official_name: Wehrhaft. Resilient. Nachhaltig. Integrierte Sicherheit für Deutschland: Nationale Sicherheitsstrategie
alternate_names: Robust. Resilient. Sustainable. Integrated Security for Germany: National Security Strategy
data.description: Germany's first comprehensive National Security Strategy, adopted by the Federal Cabinet on June 14, 2023 under the concept of 'Integrated Security' (Integrierte Sicherheit) across three dimensions: Defence-mindedness (Wehrhaft), Resilience (Resilient — including cyber, space, and critical infrastructure protection), and Sustainability (Nachhaltig).
data.notes: Coordinated by the Federal Foreign Office (Auswärtiges Amt) across all federal ministries.
